title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Can we edit data directly in FactBox?
summary: FactBoxes cannot be directly edited as they are display-only areas, but the post demonstrates three workaround approaches: importing external files, opening dedicated edit pages through actions or triggers, or modifying data through field triggers like OnAssistEdit.
key_points: FactBoxes are read-only display areas on the right side of pages that show related information
Direct editing of FactBox content is not possible through customization, but workarounds exist
Data can be indirectly modified by importing files, launching edit pages via actions, or using field triggers with OnAssistEdit
The OnAssistEdit trigger allows opening a full page editor when clicking a field in a FactBox
Field triggers can perform calculations or modifications without opening a separate page

quotes.text: the content in the Factbox is not editable. This is because Factbox is only used to display data.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the fundamental limitation of FactBoxes as display-only controls
